competing_explanation: Additional Haze4K-to-ITS overlaps may remain among the 574 parent-unresolved groups, while some directly accepted IDs may be visually duplicated members rather than one privileged source filename. The assets therefore define conservative known-overlap quarantine populations and cannot support a claim of complete unseen-scene disjointness.
